Follow [docs/ai/read-lists/review.md](../../docs/ai/read-lists/review.md).
Report only findings you are confident about: file (line numbers are fine in
ephemeral chat replies), problem, impact and a suggested fix or test. If there
are none, say so and list what you could not verify. Do not edit files.
